mask_convention: G2 complete-layer mask (32/40/32/32/42 per surface). Applied by species+position mapping from G2 CONTCAR. This is a COMPLETE-LAYER constraint — every atomic plane is either fully fixed or fully free. Differs from T1.16 which used a partial-layer bottom-half rule.
purpose: Clean-slab reference with same G2 complete-layer mask as ads.
